prompt: A cartoonish animated flame character with arms, legs, eyes, and a mouth, floating on its back in calm water. The flame looks sad and frustrated, unable to grow due to the surrounding water. Its weak flickering body has soft orange and yellow hues, avoiding overly bright colors. The scene is viewed from a low-angle front perspective (contrapicado), emphasizing the character’s helplessness. The water is vast, smooth, and reflective, mirroring the dim glow of the flame. The character’s arms and legs are slightly spread, floating weightlessly. The art style is comic and animated, with soft shading and expressive features, creating a melancholic yet whimsical mood." --v 6.1
